title: Infinity and not-a-number
refs: YAML 1.1 types (yaml.org/type): bool, int, float, timestamp, merge, value
notes: The Core schema and YAML 1.1 write infinity and not-a-number as `.inf`, `-.inf` and `.nan` (also in the capitalised forms). Any other spelling, such as `Infinity` or `NaN`, reads as a string.
